scope: Standing Tehran Museum of Contemporary Art in Laleh Park, with most galleries below grade, a stepped stone and cream concrete envelope, a terraced sculpture court and copper-clad roof light catchers.
era: Standing 1977 museum and its permanent exterior, with the current mapped outline and entrance.

review.notes: Qualla’s cleared building candidate is a photograph of a 1975 design model with unclear architectural-model rights and no confirmation that its proposed exterior was built as shown. Excluded it and other unclear or attribution-required photos. The shape is reconstructed from mapped geometry, site relief and written architectural facts.
